title: Japan Launches Martian Moon Sample Return Mission
excerpt: Japan has launched the MMX mission to collect samples from Phobos, the Martian moon, with landings planned for 2029.
body_html:
Japan has officially initiated a new space mission aimed at returning a sample from Phobos, one of the moons of Mars. The spacecraft, known as MMX, has been launched on its journey toward the Martian system.

According to the mission timeline, the critical phase is scheduled to take place in 2029. During this period, the spacecraft will attempt to land up to two times on the surface of Phobos to gather material.
